title: Validate Task Outcome schema bindings provenance privacy and claims
rawUserRequest: Implement the Task Outcome validator described by the execution plan: validate JSON Schema, bindings, provenance, event relationships, privacy, JSON/Markdown parity, conditional avoided-impact claims, no-score rules, and residual-risk visibility. Execute this Work Item serially through its own PR and lifecycle closure.

declaredIntent.summary: Validate generated Task Outcome artifacts against schema, evidence bindings, privacy and claim policies.

outOfScope: Generator derivation rules and event recording; owned by WI14/WI15.
Standalone Markdown rendering, lifecycle integration, PR summaries, multilingual output, and release publication.

sources.reason: Plan Extension defines validator responsibilities and claim restrictions.
WI15 generator output and Markdown parity source.
WI14 append-only event relationships and privacy conventions.

riskAssessment.reason: The validator is a fail-closed evidence gate over generated artifacts and must reject privacy leaks, invalid bindings, unsupported claims, and hidden residual risks.

executionDecision.reason: Validator scope, evidence sources, acceptance, scenarios, and serial authorization are explicit.

preReviewWarnings: Replace with task-specific review focus, or clear when no special review focus remains.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The validator checks the WI13 schema, required bindings, commit/PR provenance, and task identity without mutating raw Evidence.

The validator rejects malformed JSON, privacy-sensitive fields, broken event relationships, JSON/Markdown parity failures, unconditional Avoided Impact, scores, unsupported quantification, and hidden accepted/unresolved residual risks.
Validation is fail closed and returns structured reasons suitable for later ai-finish integration; valid empty reports and all five statuses pass.
Focused tests cover valid/invalid schema, bindings, provenance, privacy, event relationships, parity, conditional claims, no-score rules, residual risks, and deterministic failures.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Valid complete and empty outcome reports pass validation.
Invalid schema, task binding, digest, commit, PR, or status fails closed.
Privacy-sensitive keys, malformed events, and broken correction relationships fail closed.
Markdown parity, conditional Avoided Impact, no-score/no-quantification, and residual-risk visibility are enforced.
All five final statuses and evidence-backed human decisions validate.

guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: Generated Task Outcome artifacts need a fail-closed validator so later lifecycle and presentation steps cannot promote malformed, privacy-sensitive, provenance-free, or exaggerated claims.
constraints: Keep generator, renderer, lifecycle, and release responsibilities in their later Work Items.
Treat residual risks and human decisions as visible evidence, never as hidden metadata.
intent.rationale: A dedicated validator makes the generated report safe to consume and gives ai-finish a deterministic gate before presentation or archival integration.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly authorized serial execution and in-scope governance updates for every Work Item.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
